seo.title: PEM Certificate Chain Order Checker | Mission Mangal Tools
seo.description: Check PEM X.509 certificate order with WebCrypto signatures, issuer/subject matching, CA constraints and explicit trust limitations. Runs privately in your browser.

supports.input: Up to 20 RFC 7468 CERTIFICATE PEM blocks, max 512000 characters
supports.output: Issuer DN match, RSA/EC/Ed25519 signatures, CA checks, pathLen, dates, SHA-256 fingerprints
supports.limits: Not trust-chain/hostname/revocation validation. Unknown critical extensions cause UNSUPPORTED.
